model.title: IF the number is more than 10 THEN clap ELSE stamp. The number is 7.

questions.q: IF score is 10 or more THEN say 'Well done' ELSE say 'Try again'. Score is 12.
questions.model: Teacher: condition 'is 12 at least 10?' Yes, true, so the THEN part: 'Well done'.

questions.q: Write an if... then... else rule for a plant: water it or not.
questions.a: IF the soil is dry THEN water it ELSE leave it.

questions.q: Core: Complete the condition cards worksheet: 6 rules, decide true or false and the action for each.
questions.a: Answers on the teacher key (one per card).
questions.model: Teacher completes card 1 aloud with the four model steps.

questions.q: Extend: Write three if... then... else rules for a robot helper at home.
questions.a: For example: IF the bin is full THEN empty it ELSE check tomorrow.

questions.q: Stretch: Write a rule with 'and': IF it is a school day AND it is 8:30 THEN log on to Teams. When is it false?
questions.a: False on a weekend, or on a school day at any other time.

questions.q: A condition is... A) always true B) a question that is true or false C) a loop
questions.a: B) a question that is true or false
options: A question that is true or false
